items.title: Copper Steadies as Investors Weigh AI Slide Against China Demand
items.summary: Copper traded in a narrow range as investors weighed signs of demand strength in China against prolonged weakness in artificial intelligence stocks that have moved in tandem with the commodity.

items.title: Volkswagen to build $4bn Audi SUV factory in US despite job cuts at home
items.summary: VW investment, creating 4,500 jobs in Georgia, comes amid Trump’s damaging tariffs, intense Chinese competition and costly shift towards EVs Audi has said it will spend $4bn (£3bn) to build its first factory in the US, as its parent company, Volkswagen, struggles with the impact of steep tariffs imposed by Donald Trump. The German brand’s chief executive, Gernot Döllner, joined Trump on stage at a campaign rally on Saturday night to announce the factory in Macon, Georgia, in an unusual move by a big European brand just days before the US midterm elections.
